01 / The perspective

A home is more than a floor plan. It shapes the rhythm of daily life.

Every home brings together the plot, the entrance, living areas, kitchen, bedrooms and the people who live in them. In the Vaastu tradition, the orientation and arrangement of these elements are considered in relation to the purpose of each space.

Dr. Ravi Rao provides Residential Vaastu consultations tailored to the needs of each family and home, combining traditional spatial principles with the practical requirements of residential planning.

03 / Scope of consultation

Every part of the home
has its place.

The consultation considers the home as a whole, while addressing the functional requirements of each room.

Plot & Orientation

Residential plots, house orientation, access, entrances and initial site planning.

Home Layout

Placement of living areas, bedrooms, kitchen and circulation within the home.

Bedrooms & Key Rooms

Positioning of bedrooms, the pooja room and other key rooms of the home.

Entrance & Living Areas

Main entrance, foyer, living room and the movement of family and guests.

Kitchen, Storage & Utilities

Kitchen, storage rooms, bathrooms, staircase and supporting utilities.

Existing Homes

Review of existing spatial arrangements and practical recommendations where feasible.

04 / Spaces

Residential Spaces We Serve

Specialized spatial guidance for homes at every stage, from the plot to the finished house.

Villas & Bungalows

Plots, entrances, gardens and the arrangement of rooms.

Homes Under Construction

Reviewing plans and layouts before and during construction.

Independent Houses

Entrances, balconies, living areas and everyday spaces.

An important consideration

Plan early. Avoid costly changes later.

A home is a long-term investment of time and money. Considering Vaastu at the planning stage allows recommendations to be reviewed alongside architectural and interior plans — before construction makes changes more difficult.

06 / Questions

Before you get in touch

Can Vaastu be applied to an apartment or a rented home?

Yes. For existing homes the consultation reviews the current arrangement and recommends practical adjustments where feasible.

Does it replace our architect or interior designer?

No. Recommendations are coordinated with architectural and interior requirements and with your project team.

When is the best time to involve Vaastu?

At the planning stage — plot selection and layout planning — before construction begins.
